findings.claim: Q3 2026 revenue was $50.1M, up 20%; systems integration revenue hit a record $16.1M, up 75%, and was 32% of revenue. Net income was $1.1M ($0.04 diluted) vs a $1.5M loss, and adjusted EBITDA was $4.7M, up 225%.
findings.source_title: TSS Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

findings.claim: TSS raised its 2026 adjusted EBITDA outlook to $21M–$23M (previously the upper end of $20M–$22M) and anticipates further systems integration growth in Q4.
findings.source_title: TSS Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

findings.claim: Year-to-date 2026 revenue was $140.5M, down 24%, because procurement revenue fell 41% to $90.6M from a record 2025 comparison.
findings.source_title: TSS Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

findings.claim: A single U.S.-based IT OEM accounted for 99% of revenues in the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 and 100% of accounts receivable at June 30, 2026.
findings.source_title: TSS, Inc. Form 10-Q for the period ended June 30, 2026

findings.claim: TSS invested about $17M in power and cooling infrastructure at Georgetown, TX to support NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform; the build-out was completed shortly after Q3 quarter-end.
findings.source_title: TSS (TSSI) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript | The Motley Fool

findings.claim: On October 6, 2026, TSS signed a seven-year lease for approximately 380,000 sq ft of warehouse space in Georgetown, Texas, less than a mile from its integration facility.
findings.source_title: TSS, Inc. Leases 380,000 Square Feet of Warehouse Space to Support Growing AI and High-Performance Computing Demand

findings.claim: Cash fell to $54.0M at September 30, 2026 from $85.5M at December 31, 2025, and deferred revenue (current) dropped to $2.1M from $13.9M; total long-term debt was about $15.1M.
findings.source_title: TSS Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

findings.claim: TSS relies heavily on non-recourse factoring of receivables from its main customer ($100.7M factored in the first half of 2026), and first-half 2026 operating cash flow was a $7.3M outflow vs a $37.0M inflow a year earlier.
findings.source_title: TSS, Inc. posts profit on lower 2026 revenue | TSSI Quarterly Report (10-Q)

findings.claim: Insiders were net sellers in 2026: the CEO sold 50,000 shares three times (April 14, April 22 and May 6) under a 10b5-1 plan, a director sold 300,000 shares at $15.87 on May 29, and the COO, CFO and an SVP also sold. The only recent open-market purchase found was a 5,000-share director buy in November 2025.
findings.source_title: TSS Inc. (TSSI) - Insider Trading Form 4 Filings

findings.claim: TSS has a $150M universal shelf registration (Form S-3 filed January 2025) covering common stock, preferred stock, debt, warrants and units; no 2026 takedown was found.
findings.source_title: TSS, Inc. Form S-3 filed January 7, 2025

findings.claim: The 10-K states TSS has a long-term AI rack integration agreement with its OEM customer that includes minimum monthly payments.
findings.source_title: TSS, Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025

findings.claim: Facilities management revenue fell 30% to $1.1M in Q3 2026 due to decommissioned modular data centers and less discrete project work.

Because nearly all revenue comes from one OEM tied to NVIDIA-based AI rack cycles, TSSI's results are effectively a leveraged bet on that customer's AI server volumes and its choice to keep integration outsourced to TSS.
findings.source_title: TSS, Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025

upcoming_catalysts.event: Q4 / full-year 2026 earnings release (date not announced)
Revenue ramp from the completed Vera Rubin readiness build-out (systems integration for next-generation NVIDIA racks)

key_risks.risk: Extreme customer concentration: one IT OEM is about 99% of revenue and 100% of receivables; loss or reduction of this customer would be severe
Possible cancellation of customer contracts on short notice, and rapid technological change in AI infrastructure
Cash burn from capex and lease obligations (new 380,000 sq ft, seven-year lease); cash fell from $85.5M to $54.0M in nine months; the company says it may need to issue debt or equity
Volatile, low-margin procurement revenue causes large swings in reported revenue

notes: Q3 2026 results were released November 5, 2026. One third-party page (biggo) mislabels the August 13 Q2 call as 'Q3', so the Q3 figures here come from the November 5 company release. No equity offerings were found in the last 12 months, though a $150M shelf has been in place since 2025; dilution comes only from routine stock-based compensation (option awards in January 2026). No convertible notes were found. No going-concern language appeared in the Q2 2026 10-Q text. No direct government-policy link was found, and data-center demand here is commercial rather than policy-driven, so policy_links is empty.
